1.explanation:
• Notification/Notification.mdx defines the MDX docs page for all Notification variants (including the Inline example) and declares how the code snippet is embedded.  
• Notification/next/Inline.mdx (or the corresponding story) contains the source example for the inline Notification, which is what the “Show code” button should reveal.  
• CodeSnippet/CodeSnippet.mdx contains the implementation of the component that renders the live code block under Docs. Inspecting it will show how it extracts and displays example code.  
• FeatureFlags/FeatureFlags.mdx (or its implementation) wraps the examples in a feature-flag provider; it’s currently what’s being surfaced in the code pane instead of the actual example.  
• CopyButton/CopyButton.mdx provides the “Copy” button and related UI logic used alongside CodeSnippet—useful to understand the show/hide toggle and code-block rendering behavior.
